verdict.rationale: React is an open-source library: its source is on GitHub, it installs into your own project and build toolchain, and it can render on your own Node servers. Nothing depends on a vendor-hosted service, so it is self-hostable by nature. Community threads confirm the relicensing from BSD+Patents to MIT. Missing for 10: a first-party license statement in the pack (licensing evidence is only community commentary), and explicit first-party docs framing self-hosting or deployment on your own infrastructure.
